patthana22.28:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetusampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetusampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuvippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho hetuvippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.28:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuñceva naahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetu ceva sahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:4.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naahetukañceva nana ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho sahetuko ceva na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:5.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuñceva nahetuvippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:6.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuvippayuttañceva nana ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetusampayutto ceva na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:7.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuṃ nasahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho nahetu sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:8.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nahetuṃ naahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho nahetu ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā ekavīsa.
